headline: The biggest paid footprint we found in Bengaluru food (~400 creatives) - landing on a site whose Contact Us page still carries a US template placeholder address.

contact.address: Tiptur farms near Bengaluru; corporate office, Bengaluru, Karnataka (published contact: support@)

ad_intro: Akshayakalpa Farms & Foods Pvt Ltd runs the largest paid ad inventory we found in this category - roughly 400 live Google creatives. The product story is world-class: APEDA-certified organic, milk chilled to 4C at farm level, 24-36 hours from milking to doorstep versus an industry norm of 72-96 hours, automated no-hand-touch milking, and a farmer-entrepreneurship model seeded in Nov 2010. Business momentum is strong - reported around INR 45-46 Cr monthly revenue with an FY26 target of INR 550 Cr, backed by a reported INR 350 Cr raise. The leaks are on the receiving side of that spend: the site, the contact paths, and the measurement layer that turns ~400 creatives into a learning system.
ad_intelligence: ~400 live creatives under Akshayakalpa Farms and Foods Pvt Ltd - the largest inventory in this audit set (Licious follows at ~300).
India's first certified organic dairy (brand claim); APEDA organic + Jaivik Bharat certified; farms at Tiptur (near Bengaluru), Shadnagar (Hyderabad), Pooriyambakkam (Chennai).
Milk chilled to 4C at farm level, moved in continuous cold chain, packed without human touch - 24-36 hours to doorstep vs 72-96 hours industry practice.
akshayakalpa.org/contact-us still carries template placeholder text: '0123.456.789 - 2 Queen Street, California, USA' - a visible artifact a paid visitor can land on today.
Only support@akshayakalpa.org and +91-9535388122 are published. There is no separate distributor/partner, bulk or gifting enquiry path on the site.
Around INR 45-46 Cr/month revenue; FY26 target INR 550 Cr; reported INR 350 Cr raise with ABC Impact / Temasek participation; also distributed via BB Daily and SUPR Daily.
findings: ~400 creatives is a scale problem, not a scale win: at this volume, spend thins out across assets and audiences unless there is a disciplined creative-testing system. Most brands running 400 creatives cannot name the top 10 performers - and if they cannot, the other 390 are paying for the lesson.

The site undermines the story: a farm-to-door premium brand cannot have template placeholder text ('0123.456.789 - 2 Queen Street, California, USA') sitting on the Contact Us page its paid traffic can land on. It is a small fix with a direct trust cost while it is live.

No B2B path: organic dairy has natural B2B lines - cafes, hotels, cloud kitchens, corporate pantry, gifting. The only published contact is a support line. Distributors, HoReCa buyers and corporate gifting leads have nowhere to go, so that demand never enters the funnel.

Freshness claim needs to be the landing hero: '24-36 hours vs 72-96 hours industry' is the single most persuasive fact the brand owns. It belongs on the hero of every paid landing page, not buried in an FAQ answer.

Own the search term 'organic milk near me': with ~400 creatives and an app + website + quick-commerce mix, the measurement layer must connect store-level demand to spend. Without clean CAPI/Enhanced Conversions, half of the signal is invisible and budget decisions are guesses.
competitors: Compete on certified organic + antibiotic-free proof; never on price.
Subscription mechanics and app retention delivering weekly orders.
Akshayakalpa's story is stronger - wrap it in a subscription + retention system.
Win with certification proof, farm visits, and 24-36 hour freshness evidence.
wins: WIN 1 - Fix the funnel before feeding it more spend

Remove placeholder/template artifacts, publish a real Bengaluru contact block, and rebuild the three highest-spend landing pages around the 24-36 hour freshness proof with subscription as the primary CTA.
WIN 2 - Creative system: know your top 10

Instrument all ~400 creatives, rank by CPA, kill the bottom third, and rebuild around 3 repeatable formats (proof film, farmer story, offer card) refreshed weekly from one shoot day. Same budget, sharper inventory.
WIN 3 - Open the B2B and gifting lines

Add enquiry paths for HoReCa / corporate pantry / gifting with a simple form, case study and price-on-request flow - and run a small always-on campaign against them. This is demand you are currently refusing.
impact: Ranked: top 10 known, bottom third cut
New revenue line, low incremental spend
